Name: StartupSplashScreen
User purpose: Display brand identity and smooth transition into root destination while preferences and remote config initialize
Primary action: Automatic transition once startup route resolves
Functional issues: No progress indicator if cold start async initialization takes >2 seconds
Accessibility risks: Low (Full-screen decorative asset)
Recommended changes: Add subtle indeterminate progress bar if startup exceeds 1.5 seconds

Name: LanguageScreen
User purpose: Allow user to select app language from 10+ supported languages
Primary action: Language selection radio items and Done CTA button
Functional issues: Language changes do not dynamically reload all system strings without activity recreation
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp item height and clear radio semantics)
Recommended changes: Apply locale configuration update immediately upon selection without restart

Name: OnboardingScreen
User purpose: Introduce core value proposition (Apple Notch HUDs & Live Activities) to new users
Primary action: Horizontal carousel swipe Next Skip and Get Started CTAs
Functional issues: Lacks interactive live island sandbox test to demonstrate notch utility before permissions
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp buttons and high contrast pagination indicators)
Recommended changes: Add 1-tap live sandbox preview buttons so users experience the notch before granting permissions

Name: PermissionScreen
User purpose: Explain and request required runtime permissions (Accessibility Notification Overlay Phone Bluetooth Battery)
Primary action: Permission switch toggles explanation dialogs and system intent redirects
Functional issues: Declares broad permissions without deep justification links to Google Play policies
Accessibility risks: Low (Accessible click targets with status badges)
Recommended changes: Implement progressive permission disclosure and add deep-links to Android system settings if permanently denied

Name: PlaygroundScreen
User purpose: Core product control activation test sandbox notch calibration status and navigation hub
Primary action: Master activation switch live test buttons (Call Music Battery) notch calibration entry
Functional issues: Advanced notch offsets (sub-pixel RGB) are gated behind Pro without previewing live on the hardware notch
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp toggle target and touchable cards)
Recommended changes: Allow live 10-second sandbox preview of RGB glow and monobrow before paywall

Name: StudioScreen
User purpose: Catalog and configuration matrix for all island notification modules and triggers
Primary action: Cards for Display Notifications Music Calls Battery Sound Quick Control
Functional issues: Header title says Studio instead of Features which can cause user disorientation
Accessibility risks: Low (Large cards with clear semantic chevron navigation)
Recommended changes: Rename header to Features and add category filter chips

Name: LiveActivitiesScreen
User purpose: Inspect ongoing background activities and media playback status in real-time
Primary action: Live media preview timer status simulated event triggers
Functional issues: Simulated timer triggers are mixed with real media playback without clear divider
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear touch targets for playback and actions)
Recommended changes: Separate live system activities from test simulators using distinct segmented tabs

Name: SettingsVaultScreen
User purpose: Global app configuration preferences theme updates rating feedback and legal terms
Primary action: Theme picker language selector update checker legal sheet triggers rate app
Functional issues: Paywall trigger CTA in vault screen competes visually with Aurora Pro hero status card
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp row items with accessible trailing switch/action)
Monetization relevance: High (Contains Native Ad Slot and Aurora Pro entry)
Recommended changes: Harmonize paywall CTA and add dedicated Privacy & Ad Consent button for UMP compliance

Name: PremiumScreen
User purpose: Primary paywall surface showcasing Aurora Pro features pricing plans and Google Play checkout
Primary action: Plan selection cards (Weekly Monthly Yearly Lifetime) Subscribe CTA Restore Purchases
Functional issues: Lifetime plan at ₹149 cannibalizes recurring subscriptions; entitlement code bugs grant lifetime for all plans
Accessibility risks: Low (Large touchable cards with clear Radio/Check semantics)
Recommended changes: Reprice Lifetime to ₹499-₹699 and fix billing entitlement persistence bug immediately

Name: DisplaySettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure notch geometry camera cutout alignment width height X/Y offset and monobrow styling
Primary action: Sliders for width height X/Y offset notch shape selector color pickers
Functional issues: Color picker dialog does not show hex preview on older Android versions; settings disconnected from overlay
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp slider drag thumbs and touchable chips)
Monetization relevance: High (Custom RGB and Monobrow gated by Pro)
Recommended changes: Connect idle auto-hide monobrow and custom ARGB colors directly to IslandOverlayService

Name: NotificationSettingsScreen
User purpose: Filter apps customize notification popup duration quick reply and privacy masking
Primary action: Per-app toggles duration slider lockscreen masking switch
Functional issues: Lacks search bar when user has over 100 installed applications
Accessibility risks: Low (Accessible switch rows with app icon badges)
Recommended changes: Add search bar and Select All / Deselect All batch actions to app whitelist

Name: MusicSettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure media playback detection equalizer visualizer style seekbar and player whitelist
Primary action: Visualizer style picker album art toggle media player selection
Functional issues: Equalizer visualizer style presets are locked behind Pro without sandbox audio preview
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear picker rows and touch targets)
Recommended changes: Provide interactive visualizer preview directly within settings screen

Name: CallSettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure call HUD incoming caller display call duration and call-ended summary
Primary action: Incoming call style picker call summary toggle contact avatar toggle
Functional issues: Call-ended summary trigger relies on PhoneStateListener which fails due to receiver statelessness
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp switches with descriptive subtext)
Recommended changes: Fix receiver statefulness and fix inverted callSummaryEnabled entitlement check

Name: BatterySettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure charging animations battery percentage HUD and low power warnings
Primary action: Charging style selector low battery threshold slider sound toggles
Functional issues: Lacks custom low battery sound picker
Accessibility risks: Low (High contrast sliders and switch controls)
Recommended changes: Add custom notification sound selector for battery full and low alerts

Name: SoundSettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure volume HUD ringer mode indicators and audio feedback
Primary action: Volume bar duration slider ringer mode style toggle haptic feedback
Functional issues: Bug in AudioVolumeObserver checks showVolumeIndicator instead of showRingerModeIndicator
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp controls with audible/haptic feedback)
Recommended changes: Fix AudioVolumeObserver line 61 to check showRingerModeIndicator

Name: ThemeSettingsScreen
User purpose: Configure app appearance (System Dark Obsidian Light Porcelain) and accent colors
Primary action: Theme mode radio cards accent color picker palette chips
Functional issues: Theme lock for free users forces System mode even when system theme changes mid-session
Accessibility risks: Low (Radio cards with clear accessibility state)
Monetization relevance: High (Obsidian and Porcelain gated by Pro)
Recommended changes: Gracefully adapt free users to active system light/dark changes

Name: QuickControlScreen
User purpose: Customize Action Island shortcuts (Flashlight Camera Bluetooth Hotspot Contacts)
Primary action: Shortcut slot reordering toggle switches contact picker
Functional issues: Contact shortcut picker requires READ_CONTACTS permission which can cause user drop-off if requested abruptly
Accessibility risks: Low (Draggable items with 48dp touch handles)
Recommended changes: Provide clear permission justification sheet before opening system contact picker

Name: AboutScreen
User purpose: Display developer attribution Surya Developer version build legal links and support email
Primary action: Rate App button Share App button Legal links Feedback entry
Functional issues: Developer email suryadevelopers07@gmail.com is hardcoded instead of dynamically configurable
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp clickable list items with external intent icons)
Recommended changes: Add UMP Privacy Options button for European GDPR consent management

Name: FeedbackScreen
User purpose: Allow users to submit bug reports feature requests and qualitative feedback
Primary action: Category selector multiline text input Send Feedback CTA
Functional issues: Feedback submissions open mail client instead of transmitting via secure backend endpoint
Accessibility risks: Low (Accessible text field with character count and 48dp submit button)
Recommended changes: Implement in-app feedback submission via Firebase Firestore or secure API endpoint

Name: ComponentGalleryScreen
User purpose: Developer design system catalog showing all buttons chips cards dialogs and animations
Primary action: Interactive demo toggles theme switcher slider controls
Functional issues: Internal development screen that must remain hidden from non-debug release builds
Accessibility risks: Low (All design kit components tested for accessibility)
Recommended changes: Ensure gallery route is strictly excluded or gated behind BuildConfig.DEBUG

Name: NotificationReplyActivity
User purpose: Transparent floating window for replying directly to notifications from the island
Primary action: Quick reply text input send action dismiss button
Functional issues: Can feel disjointed from the island overlay if animation timing is misaligned
Accessibility risks: Low (Direct input focus with IME padding)
Recommended changes: Hook up directly to island notification reply actions or remove dead declaration

Name: CallHistorySheet
User purpose: Display recent calls and quick redial / message shortcuts
Primary action: Call item tap to dial dismiss sheet
Functional issues: Relies on CallHistoryRepository which is never populated due to TelephonyStateReceiver bug
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp list rows with phone icon)
Recommended changes: Populate call history reliably once receiver statefulness is fixed

Name: ExitConfirmationDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog on back press from root tab
User purpose: Confirm app exit and display exit native advertisement for non-Pro users
Primary action: Exit CTA Cancel CTA Native Ad Card
Functional issues: Native ad card in exit dialog can cause perceived delay if AdMob fails to preload
Accessibility risks: Low (48dp action buttons with distinct styling)
Recommended changes: Preload exit native ad during main session to ensure instantaneous rendering

Name: RatingDialog
User purpose: Prompt satisfied users to rate Aurora Dynamic Island on Google Play
Primary action: 5-star rating selector Rate on Play Store CTA Not Now
Functional issues: Lacks in-app Google Play In-App Review API integration (redirects to external Play Store)
Accessibility risks: Low (Large touchable star icons and clear action buttons)
Recommended changes: Integrate Google Play In-App Review API (review-ktx) for seamless in-app rating

Name: FeedbackDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog triggered when user rates 1-3 stars
User purpose: Capture constructive feedback from dissatisfied users before they post negative public reviews
Primary action: Feedback text field Send CTA Cancel CTA
Functional issues: No offline queueing if feedback is submitted without network connection
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear focus and 48dp action buttons)
Recommended changes: Queue negative feedback locally in DataStore if network is unavailable

Name: BatteryOptimizationDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog on Android 12+ OEM kill detection
User purpose: Guide users to disable aggressive OEM battery optimization killing background services
Primary action: Open Battery Settings CTA Remind Me Later
Functional issues: Does not detect specific OEM manufacturer (Xiaomi/Samsung/Realme) to provide tailored step-by-step instructions
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear primary action button and explanatory text)
Recommended changes: Add manufacturer-specific detection (Build.MANUFACTURER) with tailored step-by-step visual guides

Name: CallSummaryDialog
Navigation route: Overlay dialog triggered when phone call ends
User purpose: Display call duration contact name and quick follow-up actions (WhatsApp Call Back Note)
Primary action: Action shortcut buttons (WhatsApp Call Note Dismiss)
Functional issues: Bound strictly to Accessibility overlay; fails completely when accessibility is dead
Accessibility risks: Low (Large shortcut pill buttons with icons)
Recommended changes: Implement rich CallStyle system notification fallback when overlay is unavailable

Name: NoInternetDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog when network fails during purchase or ad load
User purpose: Inform user that internet connection is required for online features
Primary action: Retry CTA Dismiss CTA
Functional issues: Does not automatically dismiss when network connectivity resumes
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear error icon and action button)
Recommended changes: Observe NetworkConnectivityMonitor and auto-dismiss upon network recovery

Name: AdLoadingDialog
Navigation route: Glassmorphic progress dialog before showing interstitial ads
User purpose: Show high-end loading feedback while AdMob interstitial finishes caching (max 6s timeout)
Primary action: Indeterminate circular progress indicator
Functional issues: 650ms artificial delay in selectTab() can feel sluggish on fast connections
Accessibility risks: Low (Non-interactive loading barrier)
Recommended changes: Replace static delay with async ad readiness callback with 6s timeout

Name: ProPaywallSheet
Navigation route: ModalBottomSheet invoked from locked feature clicks
User purpose: Contextual paywall sheet showing locked feature benefit and plan options
Primary action: Plan selection chips Upgrade CTA Watch Ad for 24h Pass
Functional issues: Shows all 4 plans in compact space; could focus on Yearly Best Value to reduce cognitive load
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear 48dp touch targets and checkmark icons)
Recommended changes: Highlight Yearly plan as Best Value and anchor against ₹499 Lifetime

Name: AdRewardDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog for claiming 24-hour Pro pass via rewarded video
User purpose: Display 7-day calendar checkmark progress and Watch Ad button with 15s cooldown timer
Primary action: Watch Video Ad CTA Cooldown countdown Dismiss
Functional issues: 15s cooldown timer resets if user closes dialog and reopens it immediately
Accessibility risks: Low (High contrast countdown and large 48dp CTA button)
Recommended changes: Persist cooldown end timestamp in DataStore so dialog reopening preserves countdown

Name: LegalDocumentDialog
Navigation route: FullScreenDialog for Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
User purpose: Display full legally compliant Privacy Policy and Terms of Service documents
Primary action: Scrollable document reader Close button
Functional issues: Text is bundled in strings.xml rather than loaded via WebView/Markdown
Accessibility risks: Low (Accessible text hierarchy and close target)
Recommended changes: Render legal documents from local assets or secure remote Markdown URL

Name: PermissionExplanationSheet
User purpose: Explain why permission is needed with Apple-grade iconography and privacy assurances
Primary action: Grant Permission CTA Cancel CTA
Functional issues: Lacks direct link to Android system app settings if permission was permanently denied
Accessibility risks: Low (High contrast benefit bullets and 48dp primary button)
Recommended changes: Add Open App Settings intent if Android framework reports permission permanently denied

Name: UpdateDialog
Navigation route: AlertDialog for Soft and Force app updates
User purpose: Notify user of new version available on Google Play with release notes
Primary action: Update Now CTA Later CTA (soft only)
Functional issues: Does not support in-app flexible update via Google Play Core AppUpdateManager
Accessibility risks: Low (Clear version typography and CTA buttons)
Recommended changes: Integrate Google Play Core in-app flexible/immediate update API (app-update-ktx)
